g.text: IN- & OUT- share common GND plane
• BAT_SW (7.4V - 8.4V): Feeds Nano ESP32 VIN directly (MP2322 regulator 6V-21V).
• IN- = BATTERY (-) RETURN: Solder 2S battery (-) lead directly to Buck IN- terminal.
• OUT- = MASTER PERIPHERAL GND: Ties to Nano GND and all module grounds.
• +5V (Regulated): Mini360 output powers single 7-Pixel Top Ring, MAX98357A, TM1637.
• +3V3_JOY (3.3V): Dedicated ADC-safe rail from Nano 3V3 pin powering KY-023 joystick.
• I2S Digital Audio: D11 (BCLK), D12 (LRC), D13 (DIN) ➔ MAX98357A Amp Pins
• NeoPixel: D5 (330Ω) ➔ Top 7-Pixel Bulb Ring DIN (Only 1 ring in entire build)
• Front Life HUD: D2 (LED1), D3 (LED2), D4 (LED3) with 220Ω series resistors
• User Inputs: A0 (VRX), A1 (VRY), D9 (SW), D10 (Sleep/Wake RTC GPIO21)
• F1 (3.15A Fast Glass Fuse, 6x30mm) on battery (+) prevents catastrophic short circuits.
• C1 (1000 µF 10V electrolytic) across +5V and GND absorbs WS2812B current inrush.
• 330Ω Series Resistor (R4) prevents line reflection & protects the ring's data input.
• NEVER supply joystick pots with 5V! ESP32 ADC inputs permanently damage above 3.6V.
• Buck Common Ground: IN- and OUT- share internal ground plane on the Mini360 PCB.
Left: D13..VIN | Right: D12..TX1 (Matches Hardware Silkscreen)
